Smith Center]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2017–18 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team''' represented [[George Washington University]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Colonials were led by second-year head coach [[Maurice Joseph]]. They played their home games at the [[Charles E. Smith Center]] in [[Washington, D.C.]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 15–18, 7–11 in [[2017–18 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in a three-way tie for 10th place. They defeated [[2017–18 Fordham Rams men's basketball team|Fordham]] in the first round of the [[2018 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] before losing to [[2017–18 Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball team|Saint Louis]] in the second round. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team|Colonials]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] with a record of 20–15, 10–8 in [[2016–17 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in sixth place. They defeated [[2016–17 Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball team|Saint Louis]] in the second round of the [[2017 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2016–17 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Richmond]]. They were invited to the [[2017 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational]] where they defeated [[2016–17 Toledo Rockets men's basketball team|Toledo]] in the first round before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2016–17 UIC Flames men's basketball team|UIC]]. Head coach [[Mike Lonergan]] was fired on September 17, 2016, after the school concluded a two-month investigation into alleged emotional abuse against his players.{{Cite news|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/colleges/gw-officials-are-silent-amid-reports-of-basketball-coach-mike-lonergans-firing/2016/09/17/836161ae-7cf1-11e6-ac8e-cf8e0dd91dc7_story.html|title=Mike Lonergan is out as GW basketball coach after investigation into verbal abuse|newspaper=Washington Post|access-date=2016-12-29}}{{Cite news|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/17566497/mike-lonergan-fired-george-washington-men-basketball-coach|title=George Washington fires Lonergan amid inquiry|newspaper=ESPN.com|access-date=2016-12-29}} Maurice Joseph was named interim head coach on September 27.{{Cite news|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/colleges/gw-basketball-promotes-maurice-joseph-as-interim-coach-to-replace-mike-lonergan/2016/09/27/99d420b2-84d4-11e6-92c2-14b64f3d453f_story.html|title=GW basketball promotes Maurice Joseph to interim coach to replace Mike Lonergan|newspaper=Washington Post|access-date=2016-12-29}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/atlantic10/2016/09/27/george-washington-names-maurice-joseph-interim-coach-wake-mike-lonergan-firing/91172980/|title=George Washington names Maurice Joseph interim coach in wake of Lonergan firing|newspaper=USA Today|access-date=2016-12-29}} On March 27, 2017, the school removed the interim tag and named Joseph full-time head coach.{{Cite news|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/dc-sports-bog/wp/2017/03/27/gw-names-maurice-joseph-full-time-mens-basketball-coach/|title=GW names Maurice Joseph full-time men's basketball coach|newspaper=Washington Post|access-date=2017-03-27}} == Offseason == === Departures === {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
